title: My Father's Story About Adam and the Garden
script: Father: [warmly] Let me tell you something my own father told me, about the very first man, Adam.
Father: Allah created Adam from clay and gave him life, then taught him the names of many things.
Father: [gently] Allah placed Adam and his wife Hawa in a beautiful garden and told them to eat freely from almost anything there.
Father: There was only one tree they were told to avoid, just one, out of everything around them.
Father: For a while, they lived happily, walking freely, eating whatever they wished, with Allah’s guidance.
Father: [cautiously] But shaytan whispered to them quietly, saying that tree held something wonderful they were missing.
Father: Slowly, the whispering worked on them. Adam and Hawa forgot the warning and ate from that one tree.
Father: [sadly] Right away, they felt something change inside them. A quiet shame arrived, and they understood they had made a mistake.
Father: [hopeful] They did not hide from Allah forever, though. Instead, they turned back to Him immediately, asking for forgiveness with honest hearts.
Father: Allah accepted their repentance, after they admitted their wrong and asked Him for mercy.
Father: [thoughtful] Still, they had to leave the garden and begin a new life on earth, learning, working, and raising a family here.
Father: I always remember this part of the story: even the very first man made a mistake, and even he needed to ask forgiveness.
Father: That tells me something important, something I want you to carry with you too. Mistakes are part of being human.
Father: What matters most is what happens after the mistake, whether we turn back honestly or stay hidden in our shame.
Father: [warmly] Adam turned back, and Allah welcomed him with mercy. Allah teaches us not to lose hope in His mercy, my child.

quiz.question: What did Allah teach Adam after creating him from clay?
quiz.explanation: The father explains Allah taught Adam the names of many things after creating him.

quiz.question: What were Adam and Hawa told about the garden?
options: They could not eat anything at all
They could eat freely except from one tree
quiz.explanation: They were told to eat freely from almost everything, except one specific tree.

quiz.question: What convinced Adam and Hawa to eat from the forbidden tree?
quiz.explanation: Shaytan whispered to them that the tree held something wonderful they were missing.

quiz.question: What did Adam and Hawa do after realizing their mistake?
options: They turned back to Allah and asked forgiveness honestly
quiz.explanation: They turned back to Allah immediately, asking for forgiveness with honest hearts, without excuses.

quiz.question: What is the father's main lesson for his child?
options: Mistakes are human, and turning back honestly matters most
quiz.explanation: He concludes that mistakes are part of being human, and what matters is turning back honestly afterward.

quiz.question: What did Allah teach Adam?
quiz.explanation: The father mentions this near the beginning.

quiz.question: What did shaytan do?
options: Asked Adam to leave the garden
quiz.explanation: The whisper made the forbidden choice seem attractive.

quiz.question: How did Adam and Hawa respond after the mistake?
quiz.explanation: They turned back with honest repentance.

quiz.question: What does “repentance” mean here?
options: Returning to Allah after doing wrong
quiz.explanation: The story connects repentance with admitting wrong and asking mercy.

quiz.question: What does the father want the child to remember?
options: Life on earth has no work
Do not lose hope after a mistake
quiz.explanation: The final lesson centers on honest return and Allah’s mercy.
